notes: The projection carries the longer reading of SBLGNT.MAT.16.2.v001 (r00-base), which the ASV translates; no new textual decision is made here (rule 12).

When it is evening is analysed as the genitive absolute's own supplied frame on the participle, with the noun keeping evening: rule 86 licenses the supplied When on a participle, and the expletive it rides with the expressed verb under rule 9.

εὐδία → It will be fair weather heads on weather: rule 66 says in terms that εὐδοκία, εὐνοία and εὐαγγέλιον head the core and never the εὐ-, and rule 68 puts the supplied subject and copula on the predicate noun.
